description: Header file defining the SecurityAgent class, which implements authentication, plugin, JSON RPC, and web interfaces for security management within the WPEFramework plugin system. It includes nested classes for token dispatching, configuration, payload handling, and directory callbacks, as well as methods for token creation, validation, and request processing.

classes.name: SecurityAgent
classes.description: Main class implementing security-related plugin functionalities, including token management, request handling, and configuration.

classes.name: TokenDispatcher
classes.description: Handles communication and token dispatching for authentication, inheriting from RPC::Communicator.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: JSON container for configuration parameters such as ACL, connector, and DAC.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: JSON container for payload data, specifically the token type.

classes.name: DirectoryCallback
classes.description: Monitors a directory for changes and loads ACLs from files.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SecurityAgent with the given service shell.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates an authentication token based on input buffer.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Returns the security interface associated with a token.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Processes incoming web requests, attaching deserializable data.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Handles web requests on a thread pool, producing responses.

methods.name: endpoint_createtoken
methods.description: JSON RPC method to create a token (conditional compilation).

methods.name: endpoint_validate
methods.description: JSON RPC method to validate a token.
